p.t: The Toys That Built The World
p.d: From Lionel Trains to video games, for the right collector our cherished childhood toys can be worth millions! Over the last three decades, people have paid some truly outrageous prices to get their hands on that elusive toy they always wanted. But which ones are the most valuable of all time?

The world's oldest Mickey Mouse animation cel, Pokémon collectors who turned their passion into one of Australia's most-trusted brands and a Star Wars LEGO galaxy so amazing, it must be seen to be believed.

A teenager teams up with the daughter of young adult horror author R. L. Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Madison, Delaware. (Jack Black, Odeya Rush, Dylan Minnette)

Clark Kent, one of the last of an extinguished race disguised as an unremarkable human, is forced to reveal his identity when Earth is invaded by an army of survivors who threaten to bring the planet to the brink of destruction. (Henry Cavill, Amy Adams)

After training with a ninja in Asia following his parents' brutal murder, Bruce Wayne returns to Gotham City and finds it overrun with organised crime and corruption in this prequel to the Batman series. (Christian Bale, Katie Holmes, Liam Neeson)

Chris fights to save one of the clinic’s favorite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now he is the victim of a hit run accident.

The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It's all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate and seven operations have failed. Jess won't give up, so Chris attempts Australia's first surgery of its kind—raising eight grand to give Boris one last chance.

West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone.

6 month old German Shepherd, Gypsy hasn't been able to keep any food down for weeks and is losing weight rapidly. But getting to the bottom of the problem is proving impossible as the petrified patient refuses to let anybody examine her.
A critically ill swan has been found caught up in a soccer net in a suburban backyard. The bird is emaciated and running out of time. Has Chris arrived in time to save the swan from certain death?
Poppy is a Fijian native dog whose nose was cut off in a horrific hunting accident, Chris has brought her to Australia for major reconstructive surgery and hopefully a whole new life.

One year-old Hero has been vomiting all day and his owners are worried he’s been up to his old tricks eating rocks from their backyard. Can Lisa help the naughty Labrador pass the rock or will he be forced to have major surgery?
Mitsy may appear to be normal but there is something terribly wrong. The rescue kitten is struggling to walk. Andrew Marchevsky is left with no other option but to operate.

Emotions are running high at the clinic. Watch as Chris reunites with Poppy to search for a perfect foster home, helps a donkey facing a drastically diminished quality of life, and has his heart stolen by a homeless cat.

Join Chris at Victoria’s Kyabram Vet Clinic, where he helps a pregnant cow survive a difficult labor and saves a Maltese terrier’s unborn pups. Back in Sydney, Tim tries to assist a magnificent peregrine falcon that’s been grounded.

Air travel is a climate killer. But if we stop flying we'll have a global logistics problem, with numerous supply chains interrupted. If we want to keep flying, it's time for a revolutionary energy transformation. Luckily, the necessary technologies already exist.

Life evolved in the sea, in a water-bound planet, but landmasses slowly appeared and aquatic life began to explore different ways to colonize it. Plants were the first pioneers, then insects to feast on them, and then each other.

Our ice hides a menagerie of life. Microbial ecologist Dr. Allison Fong goes on a journey to uncover the mighty power of these tiny creatures. From life-saving cures hidden in volcanic ice caves, to alien-like worms with bizarre adaptations, to blood-red algae that could transform distant glaciers.

22 July 1946. The headquarters of the British Army in Palestine is located in the luxurious King David Hotel. Members of the Irgun, the Jewish resistance movement, smuggle milk churns packed with explosives into the hotel and hide them in the basement.

30 September 1956. For over a century Algeria has been a colony of France and the Algerians are fed up with it. A young Algerian woman visits a bar in the European quarter of Algiers. She orders ice cream, plants a bomb underneath her chair, and leaves the establishment.

5 September 1972. For the first time ever, the Olympic Games are broadcast live on television. Early in the morning of September 5, eight Palestinians, members of the Black September movement, attack the apartments of the Israeli delegation and kill two athletes.

2 August 1980. A suitcase is left in the lobby of Bologna Central Station and explodes not long after. The gigantic explosion rips the station building apart and a train waiting to leave for Chiasso is torn to shreds. 85 people are killed and 200 are injured.

12 October 2000. The American naval vessel USS Cole docks in Aden, Yemen to refuel. Two men approach in a small boat. They wave to the crew before ramming the ship at full speed. The resulting explosion kills seventeen sailors.

22 July 2011. Anders Breivik detonates a bomb in Oslo's government quarter. In the midst of the ensuing chaos, he drives to the island of Utøya, where youth members of the Labour party have just started their annual summer camp. When he arrives, he opens fire on the young adults.

After defeating Owen Shaw and his crew, Dominic, Brian and the rest of the crew return to the US and live the normal life again, but Owen's older brother, Deckard Shaw, is after Dominic, seeking revenge for the death of his brother.
A veteran cop and an assassin track an ex-convict who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.
When a criminal plot endangers the beach, Mitch Buchannon leads his elite squad of lifeguards on a mission to prove that one doesn't need to wear a badge to save the bay.

Hulking lawman Luke Hobbs teams up with lawless operative Deckard Shaw to battle a cybernetically enhanced soldier who possesses superhuman strength, a brilliant mind, and a lethal pathogen that could wipe out half of the world's population.
S1 E89 — One Contact TazePolice question a homeless man sleeping in a parking space. Cops plan a sting operation to capture a dangerous man. Two men are questioned about possible drug possession.
S1 E8 — Episode 8Following the Department of Homeland Security Customs and Border Protection agency as they operate on the 28 bridges connecting the United States of America and Mexico.
S12 E11 — Episode 11Join Rob Lemoto for a closer look at the dramatic working lives of New Zealand's police force and the Kiwis who end up on the wrong side of the law.
S12 E12 — Episode 12Join Rob Lemoto for a closer look at the dramatic working lives of New Zealand's police force and the Kiwis who end up on the wrong side of the law.
S12 E5 — Pie & SauceThe driver a new 'old' car is spoken to from Officers Andy Oakley and Cam Manniche about his lack of plates. His excuses don''t wash with veteran Andy.

S12 E6 — Big TroubleOfficers Anthony Deason and Paul Holtzinger pull over a duo who have swapped seats in their vehicle trying to skirt the law. A forthcoming man admits to officers of drinking before driving.
S12 E9 — Bourbon BluesOfficers Anthony Deason and Paul Holtzinger pull over a duo who have swapped seats in their vehicle trying to skirt the law.

S12 E7 — Old But GoldA driver on a phone turns into a peculiar conversation about being from outer space. As a driver makes a right turn, his impatience and a burnout leads him to necessary chat with officer Mick MCrann.
S3 E7 — Episode 7A man is rushed to hospital after his hand is amputated at work. A teenage motocross rider breaks his femur & a stroke victim needs urgent care.
S3 E8 — Episode 8A head-on collision leaves a pregnant woman critical. A builder's worst nightmare becomes reality & a teenager comes off his road bike at high speed.
S3 E2 — Episode 2With three million dashcams now in vehicles, a look at some of Britain's worst driving offenders.

S7 E9 — Episode 9The feds are called when something illegal is discovered in the bags of a laid-backed Englishman. A young couple are shocked when they realise who gave the tip off about their secret location.
S7 E10 — Episode 10A sting at one Australia's most remote airports ends with a significant seizure. Officers are amazed to find a whole new method to smuggling drugs.
S7 E11 — Episode 11An American's behaviour becomes increasingly bizarre and officers need to predict what his next move will be. Customs shuts the door on a major drug shipment from Hong Kong.
S7 E12 — Episode 12A passenger makes a strange admission that he is here to deliver a children's book but officers have a different read of the situation.

Skilled operatives travel to an island research facility to secure life-saving DNA from dinosaurs. As the top-secret mission becomes more and more dangerous, they soon make a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.
A man embarks on a journey across five continents and seven oceans in a desperate bid to overcome fear and trauma, and reclaim his life.

William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece "Hamlet.".

Jesse Stone has settled into life as the police chief of the small New England town of Paradise, Massachusetts when the body of a teenage girl is found floating in a local lake. Stone discovers that the once straight-A student had started down a path of self-destruction and was estranged from her parents who never reported her missing.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
Chronicling Jacinda Ardern's tenure as New Zealand PM, navigating crises while redefining global leadership through her empathetic yet resolute approach.

Rickey, an energetic and free-spirited young man with a Peter Pan complex, convinces his long-time friend Glenn to hit pause on his blissful domestic life and embark on an impromptu road trip across California.
Maya squares off against the masked killers one last time in a brutal, full-circle reckoning of survival and revenge.

Quarterback Cameron Cade trains at an isolated compound with his hero, Isaiah White. As training progresses, Isaiah's charisma turns into something darker, sending Cam down a disorienting rabbit hole that may cost him more than he ever bargained for.

A military-grade robotic weapon known as Amelia becomes increasingly self-aware and dangerous to the human race. Hoping to stop it, Gemma, an advocate for oversight of AI, decides to resurrect M3GAN, making it faster, stronger, and more lethal.

Violet is a widowed mother who goes to a restaurant to meet Henry, her charming and handsome date. However, she soon receives phone messages from a mysterious, hooded figure who threatens to kill her young son and sister unless she kills Henry.
Follows two Brit police officers Thomas Wilkin and Geoffrey Morton in their hunt for charismatic poet and Zionist freedom fighter Avraham Stern, who was plotting to evict British authorities.
Thrown together under tragic circumstances, three generations of women from the same family are forced to learn to live together on a small rural chicken farm in New Jersey.

p.t: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
p.d: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.
As college tests their relationship, a freshman quarterback and a promising dancer navigate love and distance while searching for who they're meant to be.
When Brooke and Gary decide to end their relationship, neither is willing to move out, so the only solution is to remain living together as hostile roommates.

A man and his ex-wife race to Bali, Indonesia, to stop their daughter from marrying a seaweed farmer. As they desperately try to sabotage the wedding, the bickering duo soon find themselves falling for each other once more.
Set on a Greek island, a young woman who is about to be married suspects that any one of three men could be her father. She invites them all to her wedding without telling her mother.
Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome and wealthy Mr Darcy, leading to the beginning of a convoluted courtship between the pair.
A 19th-century Russian aristocrat faces a difficult decision when her husband finds out about her scandalous affair with a dashing cavalry officer.
A false accusation changes forever the lives of a young teen, her older sister and the latter's innocent lover.

After a one-night stand, a couple decide to get married. However, it turns out to be a rocky road when both parties have to compromise their own cultural traditions.

p.t: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
p.d: An advice columnist attempts to make a man dump her in 10 days, but he makes a bet with his boss that he will make her fall in love with him.
Zora Bennett leads a team to a deadly island lab to retrieve dinosaur DNA with life-saving potential, but they uncover a shocking secret buried for decades.
With ruthless tactics and a strict sense of honour, crime boss Frank Lucas rules Harlem's chaotic drug underworld. An outcast cop sets out to bring down Lucas's multimillion-dollar empire.
Forced into slavery by the corrupt heir to the throne, Roman general Maximus becomes a gladiator. His prowess in the arena leads him to Rome, the Colosseum, and a showdown with the new emperor.

p.t: Once Upon A Time... In Hollywood
p.d: A faded television actor and his stunt double strive to achieve fame and success in the final years of Hollywood's Golden Age in 1969 Los Angeles.
After failing to fight for his family during a robbery, an unassuming father calls on skills from his hidden past to become a lethal vigilante blazing a wild ride to revenge.
A family must navigate their lives in silence to avoid mysterious creatures that hunt by sound.
A spy is on a mission to disprove false accusations made against him by the very government organisation that he works for.
A secret agent is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera.
Ethan Hunt must bring down a ruthless villain and rescue his fiancee.
Four high-school kids discover an old video game console and are immediately drawn into the game's jungle setting, learning you don't just play Jumanji, you must survive it.
As they return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, nothing is as they expect. They will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored to escape the world's most dangerous game.

Brad Pitt stars as a hitman whose latest mission puts him on a bullet train travelling from Tokyo to Morioka, alongside deadly adversaries from around the world. The question is: who will make it off the train alive at the final station?

p.t: The Standard Snowboard Show: Street Dreams
p.d: S8 E4Follow the Helgason brothers along with Gulli Gudmundsson, Jeremy Jones and Nic Suave as they assault urban terrain across the globe.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Arctic Man
p.d: S4 E3The crew heads down to Paxson, Alaska for Arctic Man, which Dingo soon finds is nothing like Burning Man, and is more like a trailer park. The problems begin when they find out there is an attendance fee and everyone is totally broke. Dingo is bummed about being at Arctic Man, but is super excited about the Miss. Arctic Man beauty contest. The guys make the most of the event and get in a couple good days of snowboarding. On their way out of Alaska, Shotgun Dan comes up with a creative way to get rid of their guns, beer, and ammo.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Dingo vs. Wild
p.d: S4 E4The guys enter Canada on their way to Grenade games and stop at the Sky High Wilderness Ranch for sled dog racing. While driving, Danny leaves Dingo on the side of the road and a huge round of Leave the Guy Behind the Bus Game ensues. Things get delayed when the snowmobile trailer detaches while driving down the highway and goes flying off the road. The guys finally make it to Whistler and get ready for the Grenade Games.

S1 E5The fuse has been lit, and Fuel TV's first show dedicated strictly to freestyle motocross has arrived. This episode features the metal mulisha vet, Ronnie Faisst, see him tear up the Mulisha compound, conquer the 80 foot backflip and get loose on the Crusty Tour Also, drop in with Doug Parsons and Jessie Olsen as they perfect the first wall-rides at GVD compound Watch a demo with Deegan, Metz, and Nate Adams Get to know the SoCal rider Jimmy McGuire and fall in love with this episode's token hottie who knows nothing about FMX. BOOM!
S1 E6Featured in this episode Carey Hart in Vegas, the Metal Mulisha and travel with Dustin Miller to his place in Nevada and compound in California to check his style.

We explore American surfing: why Tour numbers are down, motivation of youth, the amateur system, and patriotism. Rather than speculate from an office, we hit the phone, tracing the coastlines, cove peaks, and conversations to understand the state of surfing in the USA.

S3 E12Louie Barletta opens up with a part even your grandmother would love. Fun on the streets of Tinsel Town with locals, Kenny Roche and Mike Rosa. Dirty Ernie takes it to the streets. Interview with Chris “Dune” Pastras and Jason Lee. Florida’s lil’ kid, Abdias Rivera caughts the eyes of Dune and Jason.

S3 E13San Diego’s Dayne Brummet lays down the show opener. Dave Swift and Darren Navarette are back with part 3 of Oregon Tour, and witness Emanuel Guzzman’s back blunt revert. Interview with Danny Way, Renee Renee and Sal Barbier. A Washington Street session with Jon Ponts, Sam Hitz, Omar Hassan, Peter Hewitt and others.

S3 E14Ronson Lambert lay down super tech tricks in an undisclosed warehouse. Tony Hawk: Canada Tour, hosted Rodney Johnson. Dirty Ernie reports from the sand gaps of Venice. Interview with Robbie McKinley and Greg Lutzka. A Backyard BBQ mixes propane, dogs, burgers, drinks plus a backyard mini-ramp and locals to shred it up.

S1 E2LOCALS is a series that takes you inside the hometowns of action sports athletes. In each episode, we meet a different athlete, like Marek Zaprazny, as they guide us through their favorite spots to ride, eat, shop, and socialize. Discover the personal side of these heroes in the places they call home.

S1 E6Shannon and Shayne search for surf in the Mediterranean and discover a unique surf culture blooming in Italy.  While there they take a course in the ancient martial art of Gladiating, as well as learn to cook a classic Italian meal.

S1 E1Reflecting on his roots, Olympic medallist and Dometic ambassador Owen Wright aims to push these young surfers out of their comfort zone and into the wild. Watch the female & power surfer from Burleigh Heads, North Shelly, Le-Ba, and North Shore explore Australia's east coast, chasing remote waves, empty lineups, and perfect conditions.

S1 E2Episode Two of the Dometic Adventure with O In this episode, Owen Wright and Vaughan Blakey lead surfers from Australia's top Boardriders Clubs-Burleigh Heads, North Shelly, Le-Ba, and North Shore-on a remote camping adventure.

To set a bride-to-be's mind at ease, TAPS checks out the venue where her wedding will be held. Then, the team examines a Connecticut mansion.
TAPS travels to the historic St. Charles, Missouri to investigate Main Street’s hauntings.

The team investigate the Burlingame and Chaffee Opera House in Carthage, Mo.; and they visit a private residence in Connecticut to help a family who believe a presence has taken over their home and children.

TAPS travel to Missouri to help three generations of a family living on what they believe to be a haunted estate; and in Massachusetts, the team investigate whether one ghost is connected to two different properties.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to Rhode Island to help owners of two allegedly haunted theaters investigate two buildings to learn if the spirits that are possibly occupying the second building is traveling between the two locations.

TAPS investigates Fort Adams in Newport, RI where the caretaker says visitors are jabbed and have rocks thrown at them. He's hoping the team can determine who the spirits are and what ear they come from. The investigators have numerous experiences including hearing footsteps; K.J. is twice touched at two different locations. Their recorders also pick up knocking sounds and a child's ghostly voice.
TAPS examines the Houghton Mansion in Massachusetts, where a tragic 1914 car crash that claimed four lives may have left restless spirits behind.

TAPS investigates at Southern Vermont College in Bennington. According to legend, the wife of the school's founder committed suicide when learning about his affair with the nanny, who, it's said, hanged herself. Witnesses report a white mist in the library, as well as voices and self-opening windows. Orbs and voices are also reported in a nearby dorm. The team collects evidence they believe points to a residual haunting.
TAPS arrive in Louisville to investigate whether a trio's ancestors still inhabit their property; and in Pennsylvania, the team work to solve a tragic hanging in the Old Cumberland County Prison.

TAPS investigate the USS Constitution, the famous ship better known as Old Ironsides, during a trip to Boston. Later, they meet historical reenacters in Kentucky who claim they've encountered spirits of early settlers in Old Fort Harrod State Park.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to Boston to investigate that the home of Edith Warton home in Lennox, Massachusetts is haunted and try to find out if the alleged increase in paranormal activity could be Edith and her husband.

The TAPS team investigates the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, OH. Employees who work with the rail cars report voices, shadows, and other disturbing activity. One man who purchased a restored car claims his came with a ghost. The team focuses on the infamous Death Car in which 26 people were killed by scalding steam and water in the 1940s.
An armory that’s been standing for over 100 years harbors a ghostly mystery.
In Detroit, the team investigates the Whitney, the former home of a 19th-century lumber baron that's now a restaurant known for spooky occurrences.

When a mother and son visit one of the oldest yacht clubs in the United States, they discover that it might also be one of the most haunted, since they become entangled in the phenomena of a frightening old family with a strange story to tell.

p.t: I See You: Together Restoring Hope
p.d: This ACCTV documentary follows the work of CBM (Christian Blind Mission) in Nepal. I See You introduces Lyn Wake, a passionate supporter and CBM ambassador as she travels to the remote southeastern corner of Nepal, far off the beaten Himalayan tourist track. Meet the Doctors, staff, patients and supporters who work together to see miracles delivered and sight restored.

p.t: 500: The Impact of the Reformation Today
p.d: A lone monk’s actions 500 years ago continue to have a great impact. Renowned Luther scholars from around the world reveal how the Reformation surrounds us more than we realise through religion, politics, and our society.

A young boy named Scott moves with his family to a new town and struggles to adjust to his unfamiliar surroundings. After hearing local legends about a mysterious Bigfoot-like “Wildman” said to inhabit the nearby woods, his curiosity is sparked - especially when strange sounds and unsettling stories make the creature seem real. Determined to prove the truth, Scott accepts a dare to spend the night camping in the forest with his new friend Hailey, leading them on a suspenseful adventure that blends mystery and coming-of-age themes as they confront their fears and uncover what’s really lurking in the woods.

Peter talks with Aron Mercer from Xceptional to learn how their experience with finding roles for neurodiverse job seekers has transformed their mindset to building teams. Peter and the team explore how a strengths based team can be the catalyst for accelerated business success.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.

At The Table is where we share, laugh and dream. Real women, real conversations, real issues. It's where you'll find information on family, health and spirituality, but most of all, a community doing motherhood together.

At New Hope Care in Brisbane, Emma Broadley is redefining the concept of family. Since 1970 the Hour of Power has been reaching viewers from around the world. The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.

Worry and anxiety don’t have to control your life. In this message from his series Lessons from Philippians, Pastor Bayless explains how you can break the worry habit and experience the peace of God. When you apply these biblical principles, God’s peace will guard your heart and mind—no matter what you’re facing. Be encouraged and strengthened as you discover how to trust God fully.

Starting with live chickens in their sleeping quarters, the teams must pluck and clean the birds perfectly before serving them family style at dinner; the winning team takes some time off while the losers take to the fields to pick peppers.

The red and blue teams prepare pasta for the evening dinner service, and the team with the highest output earns a day at the Santa Monica Pier; one team's chances are jeopardized when an accident in the kitchen sends a contestant to the hospital.
The first challenge for the remaining eleven chefs: make a gourmet pizza. The winners enjoy gourmet burgers in Santa Barbara while the losers prepare for the night's dinner service.

When a picky 16-year-old comes to Hell’s Kitchen for her fantasy birthday bash, the chefs find themselves catering to one of their toughest critics yet...teenagers. The two teams must call on their inner-adolescent to design a teen-pleasing menu for the girl’s special day.
Chef Ramsay makes the nine remaining chefs take a blindfolded taste test. The winners get to go to a spa; the losers must clean the dorm.

The group dynamics are drastically changed when Chef Ramsey asks for a volunteer to switch sides. This week's challenge consists of creating 4 new dishes from 20 ingredients. One chef requires a medic after injuring himself during the challenge.

It's all about speed and accuracy as the teams are challenged to prepare dishes in a relay race. The winners are treated to a day of fun in the sun as they head to the beach for private surfing lessons. The losing team is forced to get down and dirty and clean the entire restaurant.

To give the remaining chefs a little added inspiration, Chef Ramsay takes them to the future location of The London West Hollywood; while in the kitchen, a chef burns his hand and the others struggle to deliver food to the diners in a timely manner.
Chef Ramsay orders the five remaining chefs to teach cooking-impaired housewives to prepare a gourmet meal. The winner receives culinary pointers from chefs Mark Peel and Ben Ford.
The final four contestants prepare lunch for surprise guests: eighty picky pregnant moms. The chef whose dish they favor wins a $1,000 shopping spree. The others must clean up.

The legendary Vietnam-era helicopter takes to the air in a pristine war-veteran example. We hear the story of an aircraft blown up by its own missiles, followed by the saga of a wounded copilot who went on to found a world-leading charity.

Developed just a bit too late for WWII, it was called an aerial anachronism: a piston engine warplane in a world of jets and missiles. However, it would fulfill its purpose during the Korean and Vietnam wars.
This is the astonishing tale of a tiny 1930s aircraft capable of reaching 230 mph. It smashed records all over the world in the hands of an almost forgotten British hero, Alex Henshaw.

One of the only two remaining examples of the monoplane built by Louis Bleriot, the pioneering channel-crosser. This elderly aircraft is put gently through its paces for the cameras, leaving the ground on one of its rare outside excursions.
This plane is the ugly-ducking aircraft that shunned the limelight, and the daylight. Learn the story of how this aircraft, an initial failure, helped win the war supporting covert operations.

Take a look at a beautifully restored example of the later, clipped-wing version of the legendary fighter-plane flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during wartime, featuring long-unseen test and operational footage.

The major port of Australia’s remote west coast, Fremantle began life as a place of punishment. But the ethnically diverse port city has since been the sight of some of Australia’s greatest triumphs… and disappointments.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim takes a trip to Dreamworld to see the mighty power of the park’s tigers, attends an emergency call out for an injured bird of prey, and tells us about one of Australian wildlife’s biggest threats, the cane toad.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim and the team take their lives into their own hands entering the Alligator lagoon to retrieve eggs from some not so happy gator moms. Later he attends an emergency call-out to rescue a funnel web spider, and visits a bat rehab centre.
Mystical powers fail to save a flooded cherry blossom wedding ceremony, medieval role play shocks guests, and a bride finally marries after waiting 55 years, and she's done it all DIY.
5 pairs head to the first Instant Hotel, owned by young parents Adam and Kathy. But what score will they give it?
It's the battle of the European titans. Will the home cooking of Greek cousins Dezi and Penny be any match for the precision of French foodies Austine and Leo?

The day of Maria's baby shower has arrived, and the ladies get met with surprise after surprise, starting with the mother-to-be showing up in a horse-drawn carriage; back in Melbourne, Australia, model Lorinska attends a birthing class.

After losing half his body weight, a diabetic Maltese terrier is placed on a drip; a ring-necked parakeet suffering from shock refuses to eat or drink; a wheaten terrier is brought to the clinic in dire need of a blood transfusion.
We head to the Barossa Valley, SA, and take a step back in time to Mark and Jannine's '50s-inspired instant hotel. When the guests enter the shed they are blown away by the '50s diner styling.
The real story of Melbourne isn’t found in the grand tree-lined boulevards or boomtown architecture. It’s hidden down the lanes and alleyways.
Rick Stein reaches the mid-point of his meander through France as he continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a chateau owner who cooks him Sorrel Soup.
James visits a cherry orchard in the Costa Blanca, meets a fisherman selling Denia shrimp, enjoys a Denton dish in a port restaurant, and we see how turron is made.

Nine of Britain's best young cooks press pause on their day jobs to put their kitchen skills to the test. Judging their every move is Michelin-trained social media sensation Poppy O'Toole and YouTube food star Big Has.
In Savoury Week, our remaining amateur bakers create Decorated Quiches, Gougeres, and showstopping Sausage Roll Centrepieces.
Hugh is amazed to look back and see how successful his mission to get people to fruit-ify their meals has been, whether they're meaty mains, fishy first courses, veg dishes, or booze.

Rick drops in on the fishing port of Boscastle and finds a fabulous seafood restaurant. Then a trip to Cornwall's only organic mushroom farm inspires him to cook a stir fry with lion's mane mushrooms.
In the Lake District, Rick shares mutton hot pot with farmer James Rebanks. He meets an intrepid shrimp fisherman and is joined by his son Jack to cook his Mum's shepherd's pie.

p.t: Eat Well For Less New Zealand
p.d: This week our young, first-time parents are struggling to quit their unhealthy take-away habit and they're spending up large on 'gourmet' baby food.
In Savoury Week, our remaining amateur bakers create Decorated Quiches, Gougeres, and showstopping Sausage Roll Centrepieces.
Gordon Ramsay hosts a fiery cooking competition in which the winner receives a head chef position.
The chefs are forced to come up with their best sweet dish to help temper the visitors who are coming back and looking for revenge, Martha and Jose are judging blind, the chefs in the cook-off.
Eight cake makers from Canada's most populated region arrive with cakes in hand, with day jobs ranging from speciality technologies and social services to full time parenting and law enforcement.
Paul gets goats and tries milking them. His cheese making is tested when Erica challenges him to a cheese contest.
Hugh is amazed to look back and see how successful his mission to get people to fruit-ify their meals has been, whether they're meaty mains, fishy first courses, veg dishes, or booze.
Three chicken-loving chefs from Florida, California and Illinois hope their poultry skills are enough to beat Alex Guarnaschelli's prowess.
Sandra and Dave search in La Duquesa, Costa del Sol. After 24 years visiting Spain, they now want their own holiday home with a sea view.
Mia, retiring early after selling her London home, plans a move near Alicante. Joining her on the house hunt is her supportive mother Valerie.
Diane and David plan a permanent move to Almeria Province. With 150,000 pounds, they hope for a three-bedroom detached house with a garage.
Mary has one day in Los Angeles to find a home after years of caring for her mother. Jonathan and Drew help her balance budget, practicality and priorities.

Energy Conservationist Andrew is building a radical self-heating home. As wife Margretta yearns for a beautiful contemporary house, Andrew's focus is primarily on his gigantic thermal experiment. But will it work?
Sandra and Dave search in La Duquesa, Costa del Sol. After 24 years visiting Spain, they now want their own holiday home with a sea view.

p.t: A Place In The Sun: What Happened Next?
p.d: Laura catches up with Dawn & Steve in Mijas, while Ben visits Graham & Yvonne in Alvor, discovering how their lives have blossomed in sunny Portugal.

p.t: I Bought It At Auction With Sarah Beeny
p.d: Sarah Beeny helps a DIY novice renovate a bungalow on a tight budget. In Stoke, Tariq races to convert a historic library into an events venue before his first wedding booking.
Mary has one day in Los Angeles to find a home after years of caring for her mother. Jonathan and Drew help her balance budget, practicality and priorities.
With one win already under his belt, Jonathan decides to go super big with his kitchen reno. Drew takes the opposite approach and embraces style over size.

Kirstie's with Chicago born Lauren and her British husband Paul. The couple has decided to settle in the UK - but with houses here not quite on the scale of her native land, Lauren has a few surprises in store.
Kirstie and Phil assist Tara and Alistair, who seek a family home in Edinburgh's suburbs with a 600k budget. In a booming market, can they outbid competitors and navigate Scotland's system?
Kirstie and Phil aid Jonathan and Lucy, living rent-free in a pub but needing a family home. With differing wants - investment vs. family space - can they find a compromise and a new home?
Kirstie and Phil search for a family home in Somerset for Olaus and Fiona. With prices 32% higher than in Cardiff, will they find a house that meets their needs and budget in this competitive market?
Kirstie and Phil try to find Alison and Arian, first-time buyers with high standards and a 145k budget, a property in Birmingham's hot market. Will they find the right home after a year of searching?

p.t: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next

p.d: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

From Colombia's high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.
Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

Rejoin the team for some post-rainy-season drama as they search for Ferinha, Fera, and Badalo, whose tracking collars are missing. Meet a new biologist who helps Lizzie recollar the jaguars, adding a high-tech device that will record even more data.

Feel the heat as Lizzie and veterinarian Joares scramble to collar more jaguars amid storms, floods, and power outages. Try to pin down the elusive Badalo before his data-gathering tag drops off and meet a new female the team is eager to study.

Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Aurora's cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzie's game-changing research in jeopardy.

Inspect a host of tiny creatures with big problems. Check out a pile of lumps and bumps that challenge the vets, who’ve been called on to help a tiny zebra finch, a green tree frog, a turtle named Squirtle, and a guinea pig with a sore tooth.

Take an emotional ride with Dr. Scott as he nurses a neglected rescue dog back to health and finds him a new home. And watch as Phoebe, a new vet at the clinic, deals with a tough surgery on her first day.

See Dr. Scott manage a rough day in the animal world: Badger needs surgery for a lump in his chest that’s affecting his breathing, Cookie develops an alarming snort, and the search is on for the owners of a lost kitten.

Go on a team retreat with Tammy as she helps everyone regroup after the tragic death of the barn's first foal. Witness the frustration as the group struggles to communicate, before Tammy takes Megan to task over her bad attitude.

Get a ringside seat at the most important equestrian event of the season, where Allie’s best efforts aren’t enough to bring home an award. Watch the day go from bad to worse when Tammy and Megan get into yet another monumental argument.
Run the gauntlet with shepherds, huskies, and pointers, who charm a big family.

Track Dr. Chris as he tries to surgically fix a wild bird’s stab wound without causing more harm. See Dr. Lisa aid a suddenly paralyzed dachshund, and find out how reptile park staff keep angry gators from turning their keepers into lunch.
Pluto the singing Dalmatian has lost his voice and Chris fears that the cause may be sinister. Pluto is very special to Chris because he was one of Chris’ first every patients.

The rehabilitation staff turns their attention to two beavers who suddenly find themselves in need of emergency lodging; a volunteer decides to give an in-depth, personal look at what life is like inside the rehabilitation centre.

Meet best friends Tammy and Allie, who are living the dream at Wendigo Farms, with a new business, beautiful horses, and a state-of-the-art barn. Learn why running this operation isn’t all peaches and cream once harsh reality rears its ugly head.

Wake up and smell the drama as Allie cooks up a plan that’s way out of line. Meet the friend she hires without telling business manager Tammy and barn manager Megan, and feel the tension as this decision undermines the trust they’ve established.

Experience the heat of competition as Allie goes up against an old rival at Wendigo Farms’ first equestrian event. Then feel the tension skyrocket when she discovers that Megan has forgotten an important saddle back at the farm.

Sense the excitement as the Wendigo Farms staff prepare for the birth of the centre's first foal. Watch preparations kick into high gear as labour begins, then feel everyone's concern when things don't go as planned.

Adam and Jamie revisit their first ever duct tape episode—discussing, dissecting and delighting in the classic. Features never-before-seen footage, viewer QAndA and behind-the-scenes insights from the legends.
Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman reunite to reflect on their adventures on Duct Tape Island, using only the legendary tape to survive and provide a means of rescue. (Final)

The team return for some fan inspired fables in Viewers Special, The Three-quel! Can bamboo be used as an instrument of torture? Will the Brandy on a St Bernard's collar keep you warm until rescue arrives?
Up, up and away! Mythbusters take on comic book classics in this Superhero Special. Now, I know what you're thinking hang on, you can't test superhero powers. They can't possibly exist.
Kari, Tory, and Grant risk their lives testing the classic myth—does wearing red really make bulls see red?

For this very special episode, Myth evolution, we are returning to some of the fans favorite topics to tackle the myths we apparently forgot. In Ninja bullet Slap, Kari, Tori and Grant put a modern ninja myth to the test.

In this episode of Mythbusters. Adam and Jamie get on the trail of some flammable Hollywood fables while Kari, Grant and Tori break out the defibrillator for some electrifying action. In trail blazer Adam and Jamie take on the Laws of motion picture physics. First off they want to know if a trail of gasoline could be the fuse for a cinematic climax

Take cover, on this episode of MythBusters, Jamie and Adam get test if an ordinary water heater, has the extraordinary ability to fly like a rocket, right through your house. This is a tale of explosive transformation.
In this episode of MythBusters, we flirt with dangerous animals, chow down on dangerous fruit , and then test how hard it really is to destroy something totally harmless.
Our very own Pirates of the Caribbean once again plunder and pillage for pirate parable and maritime myth. Over one exciting hour the team will tackle three tall tales of hi-jinks on the high seas.
Adam and Jamie test a mythical Confederate steam-powered machine gun, while Tory, Grant, and Kari put stretching claims to the test for science.
Mythbusters Airplane Hour takes off! Adam and Jamie attempt to land a commercial plane in NASA's flight simulator—with zero flying experience.

Tuxedos at the ready as Mythbusters take on 007 in this Bond special. Our stealthy agents are on a mission to explode the myths about Bond's gadgets, getaways and guns. Licensed to thrill— you'll be shaken AND stirred.
In this episode of Mythbusters, surfs up dude! Kari, Tori and Grant take on a gnarly Internet myth, they’re testing if a couple of sticks of dynamite can create ideal surfing conditions.
It’s a three-myth blockbuster episode! Adam and Jamie wrestle at the controls of a controversial myth and then the guys tackle the monster myth, Airplane on a Conveyor Belt!
The African Penguin is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa, and it is found nowhere else.
At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a place like no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand it.
In the heart of the Pantanal wetlands lies a region so remote that it is almost entirely unvisited. 300 pig-like peccaries call this unique place their home.

p.t: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden
p.d: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden tells the emotional story of a mother giraffe, Mama Twiga, and the struggles of young giraffes and gazelles as they take on the risks of growing in the wilds of Swahili.
The river really belongs to the hippos. The world's largest concentrations of hippos are found here. They spend their days submerged, keeping cool in the hot sun.
Along the bank of the Luangwa River in Zambia is a troop of eighty or so baboons. This is the story of a family, and a young male baboon who faces difficult choices as he comes of age.
In the Luangwa Valley, Zambia, we spend one day and one night with Africa's most fearsome hunters - A pride of lions.

It’s the end of November in the Luangwa Valley, and the rains have just begun. It marks the end of one of the toughest dry season on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to luscious wetland.
Fraser Island: The largest sand island on Earth, Fraser Island nurses a huge variety of wildlife on its unforgiving terrain, including dingoes, wallabies and sea eagles.

In this programme we look at the Vredefort Crater in South Africa and the life it supports. From rocky outcrops to grassland, and from wetlands to mighty rivers, each habitat provides a niche for a host of creatures.
Hidden within the Kalahari Desert and pulsating with natural beauty, the Okavango attracts scores of animals to its lush waters.
Explore the riveting dramas that play out amongst predators and their prey.
Get schooled in the art of protection by nature's most successful survivors.
Investigate the power of kinship and see why family shapes every animal's story.

Head to the heart of Central Kalimantan, Borneo—home to one of the most unique schools in the world. There are 68 students in all, including class clown Valentino (who loves a short-cut) and class couple Darril and Liti (who have their first fight).
When a wife calls 911 to report her husband has been shot on a country road in Texas, officers rush to the scene.

A look at the case of con man John Meehan, including interviews with his wife and her daughter, his ex-wife, law enforcement officers, and the Los Angeles Times reporter who shined a spotlight on the story.
When two tragic deaths occur within one week of each other in a wealthy city in California, families begin to wonder what happened inside a beachfront mansion.
When a young Army medic based at Ft. Bragg, N.C., goes missing, police can't solve the case despite having a suspect until an unorthodox private investigator steps in to help.

Two young girls in Washington are snatched in broad daylight while riding their bikes; the case goes unsolved for decades, until a new detective with a local connection to the story tries to solve the mystery.
Former DEA agent Andrew Hogan details his search for Mexican drug lord Joaqu??n "El Chapo" Guzm?n with never-before-seen videos and photographs.

The compelling story of the infamous killer Charles Manson is recounted, using archives, never-before-seen footage and rare interviews that showcase the murder mystery that took over the news headlines during the summer of 1969.
A teenager is convicted of encouraging her boyfriend to kill himself; exclusive interviews with those on both sides of the case.
A popular high school student is found murdered in her bed; two students help police solve the case.
A woman continues searching for answers after the investigation into her daughter's murder goes cold.
A recent law school graduate in Georgia who has a promising future disappears without a trace.

A 21-year-old college senior is shot and killed in a public park just months before her graduation.
When a hard-charging boss in Arizona is shot to death, police uncover a complex web of bruised egos in his professional life and a trail of broken hearts in his personal life.

p.d: It's a night of red-hot fiery flavours as Adam, chef Tom Hitchcock and comedian Urvi Majumdar spice things up in the kitchen.
The bikers head to southern Spain, from Valencia to Torremolinos, to eat as much Spanish cuisine as they can.
Hugh cooks a full Springlike breakfast with the help of the River Cottage hens and veg patch; some super-charged pedals power a foraging mission and a wild lunch with an old friend.
Off the SA coast, Matt discovers oysters grown in cool Southern Ocean bays, then joins a beloved local ritual at the island's only Thai eatery, a Thursday night institution.
Steph makes budget-friendly but delicious party dishes, including potato salad, barbecue chicken wings and a funfetti cheesecake.
This week Neven is in Madeira, a spectacular island in the Atlantic Ocean. Madeira's subtropical climate creates the perfect environment for producing unique food and drink.
Madeira is renowned for its bananas which are smaller and sweeter than those we eat in Ireland, and are mainly imported from Central and South America.
Rick explores his passion for fresh and unusual salad leaves with a trip around an organic market garden called Soul Farm, and is inspired to make a radicchio tart.
After a merry visit to a maker of botanical spirits, Rick adds a cheeky nip to his version of the Platinum Pud, the official pudding of our late Queen's Jubilee.
Prue is joined in her kitchen by food critic, Jimi Famurewa. Self-confessed picky eater, Jimi tells Prue how much he dislikes fruit in savoury food, so she makes him a classic Coronation Chicken.

James visits Spain's wine region of La Rioja and a mile-long cellar. He also eats tapas in the region's capital, Logroño, explores a Michelin-starred restaurant in a tiny town and cooks quail, tapas, tomatada and leeks.
Aaron completes his culinary expedition of the Top Western Cluster group by visiting Saibai Island, the most northern island in the Torres Strait.
